catalog.ask.body1: {ask_name} wuxuu u shaqeeyaa sidii saaxiib khibrad leh oo akhrin kara diiwaanka beertaada. Isku day su'aal sida:
catalog.ask.body_with_data: Jawaabuhu waxay sawiraan diiwaanka aad ku xidhatay oo tus waxay ku salaysan yihiin.
catalog.ask.body_without_data: Ilaa aad isku xidho diiwaanka goobta, jawaabuhu waxay ku tiirsan yihiin aqoonta guud ee beeraha, oo AGRO-AI waxay kuu sheegaysaa marka ay u baahan tahay in xogtaadu noqoto mid gaar ah.
catalog.ask.example1: Waa kuwee beeraha aan mudnaanta siinno waraabka usbuucan?
catalog.ask.example2: Maxaa iska beddelay isticmaalka biyaha marka loo eego bishii hore?
catalog.ask.example3: Maxaa caddayn ah oo aan weli ugu baahanahay warbixintayada u hoggaansanaanta xigta?
catalog.ask.headline: Weydii su'aalaha aad la macaamilayso maalin kasta
catalog.ask.preview: Ka bilow su'aal aad weydiin lahayd khabiirka beeraha ama maareeyaha waraabka.
catalog.ask.subject: Su'aalaha ku saabsan ganacsigaaga beerta, ayaa lagaga jawaabay {ask_name}
catalog.common.button_fallback: Haddii badhanku shaqayn waayo, ku koobiye xidhiidhkan biraawsarkaaga:
catalog.common.reason: Waxaad helaysaa iimaylkan sababtoo ah waxaad abuurtay AGRO-AI akoon {organization}.
catalog.common.unsubscribe: Ka-noqoshada AGRO-AI iimaylada soo dhawaynta ah
catalog.common.unsubscribe_note: Koontada, amniga, iyo iimaylada biilasha lama saameeyaan.
catalog.connect_data.body1: AGRO-AI kuma weydiiyo inaad beddesho kontaroolayaasha, dareemayaasha, ama xaashida xaashida. Waxay ka akhriyi iyaga. Soo rar diiwaanka waraabka, dhoofinta kontaroolaha, ama diiwaanka goobta, ama ku xidh nidaamka la taageeray.
catalog.connect_data.body2: Marka xogtaada la soo galo, talooyinka, hubinta u diyaargarowga, iyo warbixinada waxay ku salaysan yihiin ganacsigaaga beerta halkii hagitaan guud.
catalog.connect_data.headline: Ku shaqee macluumaadka aad hore u haysatid
catalog.connect_data.preview: Isticmaal nidaamyada iyo faylasha aad hore u haysatid. Ma jiro wax u baahan in la beddelo.
catalog.connect_data.subject: Keen diiwaanka goobtaada AGRO-AI
catalog.connectors.available: Xidhiidhada la heli karo waxaa ka mid ah: {connectors}.
catalog.connectors.body1: Inta badan ganacsiyada beeruhu waxay horeyba u isticmaaleen dhowr habab: kantaroolayaasha waraabka, xogta cimilada, diiwaanada goobta, iyo dukumentiyada la wadaago. AGRO-AI ku xidha iyaga si akhbaartu hal meel ugu taal.
catalog.connectors.body_free: Qorshaha {plan_free} waxaad si toos ah u soo dejisan kartaa faylasha. Xiriirinta tooska ah waxaa lagu daray qorshaha {plan_professional}
catalog.connectors.body_paid: Qorshahaaga waxa ku jira isku xidhka tooska ah. Mid kasta oo aad ku darto waxay soo jeedinaysaa talooyin iyo warbixinno dhammaystiran.
catalog.connectors.headline: Loo dhisay si uu ula shaqeeyo nidaamyadaaga jira
catalog.connectors.preview: AGRO-AI la shaqeeya kontaroolayaasha iyo diiwaanada aad hore u haysatey.
catalog.connectors.subject: Ku xidh AGRO-AI nidaamyada aad hore u isticmaashay
catalog.field.body1: Marka qof ku sugan goobta uu arko soo bixitaan aan sinnayn, daadsan, ama diiqad goos goos ah, {field_name} u oggolow inay ku duubaan goobta: qoraal cod, sawirro, sharraxaad gaaban, iyo goobta.
catalog.field.body2: Indho-indheynta waa la keydiyaa xitaa iyada oo aan la isku xirin oo la isku dhejin marka aaladda dib ugu soo noqoto onlaynka, markaa kooxdaadu waxay haysaa rikoor taariikhi ah oo ku xiran garoonka halkii fariin lumay markii ay kooxdu wada sheekaysanayeen.
catalog.field.headline: U rog kormeerada goobta diiwaanno waxtar leh
catalog.field.preview: Ku duub indho-indheynta cod, sawir, ama qoraal, xitaa iyada oo aan calaamad lahayn.
catalog.field.subject: Qabso waxa aad ku aragto garoonka dhexdiisa
catalog.market.body1: Gudaha AGRO-AI, garaadka dalagga iyo suuqa ayaa isugu yimaadda {market_name}. Ku dar boos ganacsi dalagga kasta iyo xilli wax soo saarkaaga, alaabada, iyo kharashyada laga filayo, dabadeed diiwaan geli heshiisyadaada.
catalog.market.body2: Markaa waxaad arkaysaa inta qandaraas lagu siiyay, marginkaaga la saadaaliyay, iyo inta dakhliga soo gala. Shaybaarka muuqaalka ayaa muujinaya sida isbeddelka qiimaha, wax-soo-saarka, ama kharashyadu u saameynayaan natiijada. Waxay taageertaa go'aamada ganacsiga; AGRO-AI ma fuliyo ganacsiyo.
catalog.market.headline: Dalagyada iyo sirdoonka suuqa ee hal goob shaqo
catalog.market.preview: Ku dar goob ganacsi oo dalagga oo arag waxa qandaraaska lagu siiyay, xadka la saadaaliyay, iyo halka lagugu soo bandhigay.
catalog.market.subject: Dalaggaaga iyo suuqyadaaga {market_name}
catalog.plans.body1: Qorshaha {plan_free} waxa loola jeedaa isku dayga AGRO-AI hal goob shaqo. Marka ganacsigaaga beerta uu ku tiirsan yahay maalin kasta, qorshaha {plan_professional} wuxuu ku darayaa:
catalog.plans.body2: Qorshayaasha {plan_team} iyo {plan_network} waxay ku daraan martiqaadyada kooxda, goobaha shaqada ee la wadaago, iyo ka warbixinta dhowr goobood oo ganacsiyo waaweyn oo beero ah.
catalog.plans.headline: Maxaa isbedelaya markaad ka gudubto {plan_free}
catalog.plans.item_ask: {ask_name}: {pro_messages} su'aalaha bishii, laga jawaabo iyadoo la isticmaalayo diiwaankaaga
catalog.plans.item_connectors: Isku xirka tooska ah ee nidaamyada la taageeray
catalog.plans.preview: Maxaa iska beddelaya qorshaha {plan_professional}, ee tirooyinka cad.
catalog.plans.subject: Qorshaha {plan_free} weli ma ku filan yahay ganacsigaaga beerta?
catalog.plans.usage_note: Bishan {organization} waxay soo gelisay {used} ee {limit} faylasha caddaynta ee ku jira qorshaheeda.

catalog.reactivation.next_ask: Weydii su'aashaada ugu horeysa ee ku saabsan beerahaaga, biyaha, ama warbixintaada.

catalog.reactivation.next_market: Kudar booskaaga ganacsi ee ugu horeeya {market_name}.

catalog.team.body1: Qorshahaaga waxa ku jira isticmaalayaasha {seats} Ku martiqaad dadka sameeya ama fuliya go'aamada goobta, sida maamulayaasha waraabka, beeraleyda, iyo maamulayaasha beeraha, qof walbana sii doorka uu u baahan yahay.
catalog.team.headline: Ka shaqee diiwaanka kooxdaada oo kale
catalog.team.preview: Shaqaalaha goobta, beeraleyda, iyo maareeyayaasha waxay ka shaqayn karaan diiwaan isku mid ah.
catalog.team.subject: Keen kooxdaada AGRO-AI
catalog.unsubscribe.body: AGRO-AI uma soo diri doonto iimaylo soo dhawayn ah ciwaankan. Koontada, amniga, iyo iimaylada biilasha wali waa la soo diri doonaa.
catalog.unsubscribe.invalid: Xidhiidhkani waa mid aan sax ahayn ama wuu dhacay
catalog.unsubscribe.title: Waxaad ka baxday soo dhawaynta iimaylada
catalog.welcome.body1: Koontadaada {organization} waa diyaar. AGRO-AI ayaa ugu faa'iido badan marka ay fahamto ganacsigaaga beer: beerahaaga iyo boosaska, dalagyada aad maamusho, iyo diiwaanada aad hore u haysatid.
catalog.welcome.body2: Ka bilow inaad dib u eegto goobtaada shaqada oo aad ku darto waxa aad ka taqaano ganacsigaaga beerta. Waxay qaadanaysaa dhowr daqiiqo waxayna ka dhigaysaa jawaab kasta mid gaar u ah beerahaaga.
catalog.welcome.headline: Ku soo dhawoow AGRO-AI
catalog.welcome.preview: Deji meheraddaada beerta si AGRO-AI ay ula shaqeyso beerahaaga, biyaha, iyo diiwaannadaada.
catalog.welcome.subject: Ku soo dhawoow AGRO-AI
